name: Cardamom
siboNotes: Cardamom is SIBO-friendly and may actually help with digestive comfort due to its carminative properties.
preparationTips: Crush whole pods lightly to release maximum flavor
Remove the outer pod shell and use only the seeds for stronger flavor
Toast whole pods briefly in a dry pan before grinding
Store whole pods in airtight containers to preserve essential oils
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants and essential oils
Contains compounds that may support digestive health
Provides small amounts of iron and zinc
